messages.subject: Cross Lagged Panel Model with Random Intercept
parts:
Hi, 

I`m trying to do a Cross-Lagged Panel Model with Random Intercept. I have a very simple model: two variables in two times. The cross lagged Panel Model is:

#CLPM KINDER - 1ºBASICO SOLO VOC
modeloVOC<-'
wm1 =~ series1 + digito1
wmk =~ seriesK + digitoK 

wm1 ~ wmk + vocK 
vocab1 ~ wmk + vocK

wmk~~ vocK
wm1 ~~ vocab1 
'
fitvoc<- sem(model = modeloVOC, data = PRUEBA1R, fixed.x = FALSE, missing = "fiml")
summary(fitvoc, fit.measures =TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare=TRUE) 



How can I do a Model with Random Intercept?? I want to compare both, the CLPM and the RI-CLPM.

Thanks you all,
Bernardita
